thread:
zoe (PM): Quick sync: Prospect Nimbus wants pilot but requires team-level controls + exportable audit. We need to decide pilot-light vs full delay.

lee (ENG): Full RBAC/UI is 4+ weeks. Pilot-light (IdP group -> team, admin/member roles, signed event export) is ~1 week and can be feature-flagged per tenant.

mira (UX): We'll add a "Pilot features" banner in onboarding and a small modal for mapping groups -> teams. Low design cost.

harry (AE): Nimbus will sign pilot if we commit to delivering full RBAC within 45 days and provide acceptance tests (Okta + Azure).

zoe (PM): Proposal: ship MVP on time, support Nimbus via pilot-light on Dedicated staging, commit to 45-day window for v1 RBAC. Approve?

lee (ENG): +1. We'll gate behind a per-tenant feature flag and canary to reduce blast radius. Action items: prototype adapter, HMAC-signed logs, feature-flag, canary deploy.

mira (UX): +1. I'll prepare banner + modal copy and link to roadmap item.

ops-bot: deploy 2729991400 -> staging/product -- success :rocket:

harry (AE): Nimbus gave verbal OK. I'll circulate amendment with the 45-day window and ACs.

zoe (PM): ACs for pilot sign:
1) IdP group mapping configured (modal or CLI);
2) role-lite enforcement (admin/member);
3) signed append-only event log exported to S3;
4) per-tenant feature flag and rollback toggle;
5) demo with Okta/Azure.

lee (ENG): PR incoming in 5 working days. We'll canary on Nimbus tenant.

harry (AE): legal wants soft language for delivery window (target within 45 days). Circulating now.

zoe (PM): Consensus = ship MVP and unblock Nimbus with pilot-light. Keep updates here and escalate any Day-7 risks. Thanks. :thumbsup:
